tools.name: chest_xray_classifier
tools.description: A tool that analyzes chest X-ray images and classifies them for 18 different pathologies. Output is a dictionary of pathologies and their predicted probabilities (0 to 1).

tools.name: chest_xray_segmentation
tools.description: Segments anatomical structures (lungs, heart, clavicles, spine, mediastinum, aorta, diaphragm) in a chest X-ray and reports per-structure metrics such as area, position, and intensity.

tools.name: scan_quality_scorer
tools.description: Scores generic acquisition quality of the scan.

tools.name: contrast_enhancer
tools.description: Returns a contrast-enhanced view of the radiograph.

tools.name: artifact_detector
tools.description: Flags imaging artifacts unrelated to pathology.

tools.name: image_metadata_reader
tools.description: Reads acquisition metadata embedded in the image file.

tools.name: bone_density_estimator
tools.description: Estimates skeletal bone density from a radiograph.
